about: Dropsea (OxyHQ/Dropsea, on @oxy.so/services 14.11.0's host mode) takes its Oxy session from the platform (docs/adr/0020-oxy-account-login.mdx, decision 6): the runtime's framework registered the machine's Oxy session before Dropsea's bundle ran, and Dropsea's own Oxy SDK, finding it, reads the account from the accounts' service (played: it knows Dropsea by its launch) and asks it for a token of Dropsea's own at boot, running no sign-in of its own. The machine is offline but for a store of the run's own (`store`), so the played token reaches no server.
